title: VTN Graph — Member Network — payload
description: A request to expand one member network's graph. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

membership.description: A person's membership credential from a member community, holder-bound to the signer; admits the person to a `members` directory.

Response.title: VTN Graph — Member Network — response payload
Response.description: The member network's graph, from its verified signed index.
